report.explanation: Mô hình LightGBM (dacn-lgbm-ember2018v2-5db192ec1bda) phân loại tĩnh: MALICIOUS (raw score 0.9983 so với threshold 0.8322; score >= threshold ⇒ malicious). Raw score KHÔNG phải xác suất đã hiệu chỉnh. Quan sát tĩnh về sections: 4 section, 4 section entropy≥7 (có thể do nén/đóng gói), 0 section vừa ghi vừa thực thi. assessment.rationale: The static LightGBM model predicts malicious behavior with a raw score of 0.998, exceeding the threshold of 0.832. Static features support this: high entropy sections (7.6-7.9), debug info present, and stripped relocations are consistent with obfuscated malware.
limitations: Evidence is from an EMBER feature record, not a raw PE bytes run; score is uncalibrated probability.
No trusted hash reputation available to cross-validate.
assessment.explanation: Static analysis strongly suggests malicious intent. Manual review is required to confirm behavior in a sandbox before execution decisions.
